subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: william shakespeare the monarch of english literature was born on april 12 1564 in the stratfoort on avon his mother was mary arden and his father was john shakespeare he was not much educated Part−B : Composition [40 Marks]
guide_solution: William Shakespeare, the monarch of English Literature, was born on April 12, 1564 in the Stratford-on-Avon. His mother was Mary Arden and his father was John Shakespeare. He was not much educated. Part−B : Composition See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 177
